scores.scale: 0 = unusable in observed scope; 5 = functional with substantial friction; 7 = good with clear limitations; 9 = excellent with minor friction; 10 = exceptional across assessed scope. Holistic judgment, not win/loss, score, or accuracy conversion. Unassessed features receive no inferred enjoyment credit.

reasons.overall_mobile: A coherent, attractive short touch-assisted mission with clear progress, usable large main targets and successful sampled two-contact combat. Small distant targets, dense typography and unclear boss phase feedback constrain confidence.
reasons.controls: Manual MOVE with FIRE drag and separate scene turns visibly worked in both runs; target selection was forgiving. Large control anchors helped. Limited paused bursts cannot establish comfortable sustained thumb play or rearming. DASH/JUMP/AIM/tools untested.
reasons.gameplay: Recovery, three-part Custodian and deck upload provided observable objective variety. Route assistance removed navigation friction but accounted for most travel and limited independent assessment of navigation/combat depth. Sustained challenge and continuous enjoyment remain unassessed.
reasons.presentation: Rain, reflective ground, cyan/orange contrast and station geometry gave a cohesive atmosphere; target-down and saved-memory overlays were clear. Audio was not assessed.
reasons.usability: Context-sensitive hold labels, objective changes, extraction map and explicit fresh start helped complete the sequence. Boss damage occurred across batches ending ARMORED, leaving phase-rule clarity uncertain.
reasons.readability: Main health/ammo, objective and terminal stats were legible. Patrol silhouettes, environmental labels and compact tactical text were noticeably small at landscape 844x390.

method.input: Helper native CDP two-contact touch JSON lines only
method.source_access: Only mobile-playtest.mjs --help used to learn helper; no source/tests/docs/prior reviews/internal state/target metadata inspected. Own generated screenshots viewed individually before adaptive input. UI result text only.
method.observation_boundaries: Requested 3000ms waits commonly shortened to about 2966–2986ms and 1200ms FIRE waits to about 1198ms; exact per-batch timings and boundaries retained in actions.jsonl. No attempt to execute skipped time. No wait exceeded 3000ms.
method.planning: Map opened once in attempt one, remained planning and was visibly closed using #close-map.
method.identity: BUILD 117 visible at title; requested source hash is provenance supplied by user, not independently verified.

uncertainties: Terminal accuracy is game-reported; individual miss count not independently measured. First-run 95% preserves observed misses without attributing their cause.
Capture metadata and image may straddle live damage; screenshot a1-coil3 shows shield 41 while that batch metadata says 60. No inference of exact impact timing.
Automatic contact release and pause materially alter continuity and observation frequency. No human reaction-time or causal quality advantage claimed.
Two wins do not establish difficulty balance, physical-device comfort or enjoyment outside this sampled assisted mission.
